Hi David —

Thanks for the onboarding call earlier. HarborTech is excited to get our PO flow connected to Redwood. A couple of items on our side:

- Preferred billing cadence: net60 standard (we operate on a 60-day AP cycle across most of our vendors).
- We are interested in the early-pay/discount program you mentioned — would consider a 2%/15 option if you can provide an enrollment process.
- To speed setup we attached our completed onboarding form and W-9. Please confirm which PO acknowledgement format you need and whether e-billing (cXML/EDI or emailed remittance) is required.

Hi Jenna —

Thanks for sending the forms over and for the call. Quick confirmation and next steps from our side:

1) Redwood standard is net30 for most partners, but we can accommodate net45 or net60 for strategic vendors like HarborTech. Need internal procurement sign-off and finance approval for net60.
2) Our early-pay program (2%/15) is run as an opt-in for vendors; finance requires a signed enrollment addendum and mapping to PO line items so discounts apply at invoice receipt.
3) For PO acknowledgement: we use the PO_ack_template.docx (attached). If you can return a signed ack against the first PO it speeds activation.
4) E-billing: we support emailed AP remittance to ap@redwood.ai and have a cXML endpoint; procurement will confirm preferred channel.

Kimberly & Marissa — can one of you confirm procurement/finance path for net60 and the DocuSign template for the early-pay addendum? Jenna, if you can send the preferred remittance channel and whether HarborTech requires consolidated monthly invoices or per-PO invoices, that will help us map the payment lane.

Thanks — I'll loop Sean for the activation checklist once procurement confirms.

Regards,
David Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
phone: +1 (415) 555-0132

Thanks. A few clarifications from HarborTech:

- Remittance preference: AP prefers emailed remittance to ap@harbortech.io with PO number in subject; if you have cXML we can pilot but need our IT to approve the endpoint (2-week turnaround).
- Invoice frequency: HarborTech prefers per-PO invoices (we code by project), but can accept consolidated monthly billing if Redwood tags line-items with PO IDs.
- We are happy to sign the early-pay addendum (2%/15) for initial pilot — please send DocuSign.

Attachments: (none)

- Activate e-billing via emailed remittance first (ap@harbortech.io). If HarborTech's IT approves cXML, we'll migrate later.
